acceptance_checks: A verdict complete with can_merge false and a failing acceptance entry exits non-zero from enforce_cca_verdict.py, naming the failing criterion.
The same verdict through mergegate_check.py blocks with a reason for the failing acceptance entry and one for can_merge != true.
A verdict with an empty checklist against a task declaring a non-empty cca_checklist_profile blocks; the same verdict with every profile id present and pass returns ready.

The needs: cca job dependency (owned by ADR 0015 T5)

findings.detail: task.schema.json adds cca_checklist_profile to its `required` array, but the same diff's validate_shiki.py comment deliberately keeps it OUT of TASK_REQUIRED ('promoting it to a required field means every pre-existing task file must be backfilled'), TASK_REQUIRED omits it, and no task file in the repo — including this PR's own .shiki/tasks/T-…48021407.json — provides the field. I confirmed nothing currently validates task records against task.schema.json (validate_task uses the manual TASK_REQUIRED path; the per-record schema loop is the still-planned task T-…f138eccf), so there is no current CI/MergeGate breakage and the PR merges cleanly. However, it is an internal inconsistency and a latent landmine: when the mirror-schema-validation task lands and runs every task record through task.schema.json, all ~98 task files lacking cca_checklist_profile will fail. Consider making the field optional in task.schema.json (matching the documented reasoning) until backfill is in scope.
findings.title: task.schema.json marks cca_checklist_profile required, contradicting the PR's own validator decision and all existing data

scope: In scripts/enforce_cca_verdict.validate_verdict and mergegate_check.main's CCA branch, reject verdict=complete when any acceptance entry is fail or insufficient_evidence, and promote can_merge is not True from a warning to a blocking reason. Block unless every id in the task's cca_checklist_profile appears in the verdict checklist with a terminal status. Adding minItems 1 to the schema's checklist is DEFERRED by a second operator-approved Spec Amendment recorded at L-20260801T000308795657Z-986c2816: it breaks empty-checklist ready-path fixtures in scripts/test_shiki_evidence_integrity.sh and scripts/test_shiki_guardian_policy.sh, both outside this task's declared locks, and widening a frozen task's locks mid-flight is what ADR 0015 contract immutability prevents. Tracked as a dedicated follow-up task. Promoting cca_checklist_profile to a required field in task.schema.json and validate_shiki's required task fields is DEFERRED by an operator-approved Spec Amendment recorded at L-20260731T103805656085Z-f5448285: it needs ~98 pre-existing task files backfilled, and MergeGate blocks a task PR from touching any task file but its own.
